newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar erodes further by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar erodes further by close.

text.p: White sugar futures edged down further by the close, but the spot December contract held its head above support.
Most active December finished the week at $328.50 per tonne, down $3.10 on the day and just 10 cents above its inter-day low.
Dealers said the losses were seen as a correction to the recent bounce, with support on December pegged at $328 and $326.
A majority of the volume was in the spot contract, 1,263 lots of a total 2,092 lots.
The March contract also lost ground, ending $3.00 weaker at $328.60.
Paris futures followed the easier trend, with December ending $2.50 weaker at $329 and March $3.00 down also at $329.
